title: Memory-Efficient Training from Scratch
blurb: Account for every byte of a training step: model states, activations, recomputation, quantised weights and adapters, then pick a plan that fits the GPU.
intro: Training memory has two parts: model states (weights, gradients, optimiser moments) that scale with parameters, and activations that scale with batch, sequence length and depth. The steps count model states under mixed precision, estimate transformer activations with and without recomputation, plan checkpoint segments, quantise weights to int8, and size a LoRA fine-tune. The capstone searches ZeRO stages, recomputation modes and micro-batch sizes and returns the plan that fits.
